**We're looking for local vendors and community service providers for a one-time Community Open Market at Sunshine Community**!

We welcome **artists • crafters • makers • small businesses • service providers • community organizations • resource groups • nonprofits • specialty vendors • entrepreneurs • and more.**
**Only 10 spaces available — first come, first served!**

📅 **Saturday, September 26 | 1–4 PM**
📍 **1321 Ute Avenue, Grand Junction**

Interested? Call **Rene 970-291-7834** or **Chris 970-712-6540**.

🎃👻 WE’RE LOOKING FOR HAUNTED HOUSE VOLUNTEERS! 👻🎃
The Gift of Love is getting ready for our Annual Haunted House Fundraiser, and we’re looking for people who LOVE Halloween, enjoy acting, or have a passion for theater and bringing spooky characters to life! 🖤🎭

We need scare actors and volunteers who would like to come out and be part of this fun community fundraiser. Whether you have theater experience or have always wanted to try being a scare actor, we would love to have you join us!

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Families are welcome! Family members can even be together in the same room and participate as a group.

You can be creepy, scary, funny, or just have fun with your character—the goal is to create an exciting Halloween experience for our community! 🎃

All proceeds from the Haunted House help The Gift of Love provide Thanksgiving food boxes and Christmas care packages to families and individuals in our community. ❤️

📍 1129 Colorado Ave, Grand Junction, CO 81501

🎃 Fridays & Saturdays in October: 6:30–11:00 PM

🎃 Sundays in October: 6:30–10:00 PM (no scare actors on Sundays)

If you’re interested in volunteering, please reach out to The Gift of Love! We would love to have you be part of the team! 👻❤️

Please share this post with anyone you know who loves Halloween, haunted houses, acting, or theater!
